This shift highlights the growing importance of AI in the financial services industry.
title: World’s biggest bank to job seekers: We want to know how you use AI

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: With a stellar unbeaten run, India's women's cricket team clinched their eighth Asia Cup title. Celebrations ensued as Prime Minister Modi and President Murmu praised the team's remarkable victory. In the final, Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma spearheaded the batting attack, while the bowling unit effectively curtailed Sri Lanka's score. The focus now shifts to pursuing gold at the upcoming Asian Games.
title: ‘Proud moment’: PM Modi, President hail India; Women’s team snubs Asia Cup trophy

author: PRACHI KUMAWAT
description: In a show of unity, the Cockroach Janta Party will support students demonstrating against the purported paper leaks in the MPSC exams. Abhijeet Dipke, the party founder, confirmed this backing after engaging with the aspiring candidates. The students are calling for the resignation of the MPSC chairman and secretary, planning a statewide tour if their needs are unmet by September 24.
title: MPSC paper leak: CJP to join protesters demanding resignation, sets Sept 24 deadline

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a recent statement, Jeff Bezos took aim at New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's approach to a proposed tax initiative. He emphasized that demonizing individuals isn't a viable strategy for tackling systemic issues. While he endorses the concept of the pied-à-terre tax, he disapproves of Mamdani's focus on targeting businessman Ken Griffin. Bezos highlighted that the real challenge lies in government inefficiency rather than imposing higher taxes alone.
title: Jeff Bezos to Mamdani: ‘Villain strategy’ won’t work; Ken Griffin isn’t hurting New York

title: Russia offers Rs 16 lakh per foreign soldier for Ukraine war: Report

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Ganges Grandmasters stunned the favourites, APL Pipers, to win the GCL 2026 title on Sunday, powered by an unconventional team culture built on humour, trust and camaraderie. First-time coach Adiban Baskaran became the unlikely catalyst, blending superstition, calmness inspired by MS Dhoni, and personal bonds with players. Ian Nepomniachtchi and Stavroula Tsolakidou delivered decisive wins, completing a remarkable underdog triumph.
title: Coach's fasting, nod to Dhoni, 'funniest' team: Inside Ganges Grandmasters' GCL title

author: PRACHI KUMAWAT
description: A woman biker claims a car repeatedly followed her on Sunday. The car allegedly hit her motorcycle and then fled the scene. Footage shared online shows the alleged collision and the car driving away. A friend pursued the car and confronted the driver at a traffic signal. The biker has appealed to Gurgaon Police for action and accountability.
title: Car follows woman biker, hits her bike and flees; incident caught on camera

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A noticeable uptick in teeth grinding has been reported by dentists, specifically in younger adults. The primary culprits behind this increase are stress and anxiety. Common signs include persistent jaw pain and headaches. Although not every case will demand intervention, it’s essential for dentists to assess any potential harm before moving forward with treatment options. Individuals are encouraged to heed their body’s warning signs and seek expert advice when needed.
title: Teeth grinding is rising among young people: Are you grinding your teeth without knowing it?

title: Oil prices jump over 2% as fresh Saudi, Strait of Hormuz strikes fuel supply fears

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: David Sacks has sharply criticized Sam Altman and Dario Amodei's calls for slowing AI development. He urged the tech leaders to halt their work voluntarily if they believe models pose threats. Sacks argued that OpenAI and Anthropic already control the industry's pace and capabilities. He also suggested their motivation might be financial liability rather than pure altruism. Sacks believes immediate voluntary action would build significant goodwill for future discussions.
title: Billionaire David Sacks to Sam Altman and Dario Amodei's call to slowdown AI development

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: In a bold statement, President Trump hinted that the U.S. could take control of Iran's oil resources following a potential conflict. He likened this situation to the American involvement in Venezuela's oil industry. Trump anticipates the war may end before the November elections, asserting that Iran desires an agreement, yet only if it meets U.S. criteria. This strategy connects the U.S. presence to Iran's oil wealth and security aspirations.
title: Trump eyes Iran oil, hints at Venezuela-style US control after war

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a recent statement, US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy encouraged Ford to cut its partnership with CATL and Geely. He voiced significant worries regarding Ford's increasing reliance on strategic rivals. However, Ford dismissed these concerns as a mere publicity stunt, emphasizing its commitment to American investments and the operation of its Michigan battery facility, which provides employment to local workers.
title: 'Upset' Ford hits back at US transport secretary; says: Your letter is factually wrong

author: TNN
description: A man absconding after his wife and three daughters' murders was arrested Sunday.  Rahul Jha was tracked down using CCTV footage and information from hotel staff.  He confessed to the murders, citing family discord and strained relationships.  Police recovered blood-stained clothes and his switched-off mobile phone from the home.  The accused was brought to Jaipur after his apprehension in Reengus.
title: After killing wife, 3 daughters, Jaipur man fled to temple seeking ‘divine blessings’

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: A US Air Force officer survived nearly fifty hours in Iran after his jet was shot down.  Over ninety American service members deployed for one of the most complex rescue operations.  The officer, injured, hid in Iran's desert while Iranian forces searched for him.  US forces used bombers and drones to strike Iranian Revolutionary Guard forces nearby.  This mission demonstrated the US commitment to recovering its personnel.
title: Shot down over Iran, hunted for 50 hrs: How US fighter survived behind enemy lines

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: India's women's cricket team made headlines by refusing the Asia Cup trophy from Mohsin Naqvi, echoing a similar stand by the men's team in 2025. Citing the turbulent military and political climate with Pakistan, the players expressed their alignment with their male counterparts. Despite efforts to navigate the trophy handover, the initiative was ultimately unfruitful, highlighting the ongoing complexities surrounding sports and politics.
title: ‘Trophy chor’ comes back again: Fans chant at Mohsin Naqvi after India's triumph

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: A retired Group Captain of the Indian Air Force fell victim to a violent attack by a parking attendant, resulting in serious injuries, including head trauma and a broken hand. The confrontation occurred over a parking dispute at Magnum Global Park, where the attendant reportedly wielded an iron rod. Following the incident, police have received a complaint aimed at launching an attempted murder investigation.
title: Kargil War veteran attacked with iron rod in Gurgaon over parking row

Following their spectacular eighth Asia Cup victory against Sri Lanka, the players prioritised the significance of their achievement, choosing to celebrate their win over participating in the trophy handover ceremony.

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Alexander Zverev triumphantly claimed his second Grand Slam title at the US Open, overcoming American contender Ben Shelton in a gritty four-set battle. This prestigious win not only solidified Zverev's comeback from his 2020 US Open final loss but also capped off an extraordinary 2026 season, where he further set records with his remarkable prize money earnings.
title: Six years after 2020 heartbreak, Zverev beats Shelton to finally win US Open

author: KUSHAGRA DIXIT
description: An Indian emissions trading scheme is now inspiring global environmental solutions.  This innovative approach incentivizes industries to reduce pollution effectively.  Gujarat's successful pilot program demonstrated significant emission reductions and cost savings.  The scheme is now expanding across India and attracting international interest.  This model offers a competitive advantage for industries embracing cleaner practices.
title: Gujarat to global: How idea to fix pollution has lessons for Delhi

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: President Trump has dismissed concerns regarding reports that Chinese entities are providing Iran with satellite imagery, suggesting that such espionage practices are not unlike those employed by the United States. This incident reportedly occurred just before a missile strike that resulted in the deaths of three American soldiers. With a meeting scheduled with Chinese President Xi Jinping, this satellite connection could create tension during their impending trade and technology negotiations.
title: ‘We spy on them too’: Trump shrugs off China-Iran satellite imagery report

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: India's women's cricket team made headlines by declining to participate in the Women's Asia Cup trophy presentation, standing in unity with the men's team from last year. The BCCI secretary linked this move to current military tensions with a neighboring nation. Celebrating their impressive eighth Women's Asia Cup title, the team now looks ahead to the Asian Games, with a focus on capturing gold.
title: ‘We can’t receive it from him’: Why India snubbed Mohsin Naqvi again

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A 17-year-old student created a groundbreaking training method for artificial intelligence that enhances communication skills in smaller AI models. This unique technique received impressive empathy ratings in various tests, paving the way for more advanced conversational capabilities in personal devices. By focusing on human-like interaction, the student's research pushes the boundaries of how we develop empathetic AI.
title: Portland teen, 17, makes small AI models 90% more empathetic
